title: Lumière!
creator: Thierry Frémaux
description: A selection of over a hundred of the Lumière brothers’ short films from 1895 to 1905, restored and narrated by the head of the Institut Lumière. Their first film was shot outside this shed.

title: The Clockmaker
creator: Bertrand Tavernier
description: A quiet watchmaker in Lyon learns that his son is wanted for murder. Tavernier’s first feature, adapted from a Simenon novel and filmed in the streets of his home city. In French.

title: Army of Shadows
creator: Jean-Pierre Melville
description: Melville’s bleak film about a cell of the French Resistance, based on Joseph Kessel’s novel and on Melville’s own time in the Resistance. Lyon was its capital during the occupation. In French.

title: Hôtel Terminus
creator: Marcel Ophüls
description: Marcel Ophüls’s long documentary on the life and times of Klaus Barbie, from Lyon to his postwar work for American intelligence and his years in Bolivia. It won the Oscar for best documentary. In several languages.

title: By the Grace of God
creator: François Ozon
description: Based on the true story of men in Lyon who came forward as adults about abuse by a priest when they were boy scouts, and the church officials who had known. In French.
